title: EmDash: the menu planner leaves sample and error-page items alone and writes labels in the site's language; Tracy Business 1.7.5 shares the customer's card over a hero picture
steps: S1: No stand and no site. From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-name-pattern="sample page or an error page|asked again in the site|keeps the English the owner wrote|the share picture" apps/tracy-web/test/brief-emdash.test.mjs packages/cms/tracy-emdash-theme-business/tests/brand.test.mjs

S2: brief-emdash runs seedMenus and planMenuLabels over the Tracy Business seed with a fake model: kit items (seed/personalize.json samples) and /404 must not be planned; an English label copied from the description on a non-English site is asked again once, then dropped.
S3: brand.test.mjs calls shareImageOf (src/lib/share-image.ts) with and without a share card (seo.defaultOgImage).
S4: Read the node:test summary lines (tests / pass / fail) and every failing test name.
expect: No item leading to /kit/* or /404 reaches the planner; their labels stay the seed's for the tool to translate.

On a Vietnamese site a label that only repeats unaccented words of the description is asked again in Vietnamese and dropped if it comes back the same; an English site keeps the owner's English and nothing is asked again.
shareImageOf: an own picture is kept; a hero gives way to the share card; with no card the hero is shared; a card without url is no card.

selectors.seam: seedMenus / planMenuLabels in apps/tracy-web/src/sites/brief-engines/emdash-menus.js; shareImageOf in packages/cms/tracy-emdash-theme-business/src/lib/share-image.ts read by src/layouts/Base.astro
selectors.door: the menu-label model (fake in the tests); og:image in the page head

evidence: Dev (cowork.tracy.site), 10/10/2026, g55-biz-emd-full (Tracy Business 1.7.4, Vietnamese): the Resources menu read 'Bánh mì', 'Sourdough', 'Freshly baked', 'Dubai' while opening /kit/newsletter, /kit/email, /kit/slides and /404 (PAGE-5, K3); the footer carried English 'Sourdough', 'Vietnamese bread' (LANG-2); the home page shared its generated hero photo instead of the logo share card (D5).
fence: Unit tests over the real seed and a fake model; no live EmDash site or model ran. The 1.7.5 theme reaches customers only after its release.

cmd: --test-name-pattern=sample page or an error page|asked again in the site|keeps the English the owner wrote|the share picture
